cohort: 95 infants born at less than 28 weeks' gestation
finding: The relationship between early morning plasma ACTH and plasma cortisol is either not established or is impaired in infants of less than 28 weeks' gestation in the first 5 days after birth.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not an independent determinant of early morning plasma cortisol concentration in infants born at less than 28 weeks' gestation.
gest_age: Mean gestational age was 25.3 ± 1.3 weeks (range 23-27 + 6 weeks)
